title: Recipe
description: Deterministic, LLM-free replay script for one onboarding video. Produced by explorer, consumed by recorder + assembler.

app_version.description: Sloneek FE version/date this recipe was verified against

start.description: How to get to the first screen. Auth is handled by recorder via env (SLONEEK_DEMO_URL/USER/PASS) or storageState file.

storage_state.description: path to Playwright storageState json (logged-in session)

provider.description: external = mp3 files already placed in out/<id>/audio/<stepId>.mp3 (e.g. generated by Claude via the ElevenLabs connector); assembler only measures them

chapters.description: Write out/<id>/chapters.txt (YouTube chapter list, times in final.mp4) from the steps' `part` / `part_title`. Only written when at least one step has a part.

interstitials.description: Insert a 1.5 s card "<part> / <part_title>" (brand colours) before every step whose part differs from the previous step's (never before the very first step – the intro covers it). mux --no-interstitials overrides.

narration.description: One idea per step. Spoken while actions run. Empty string = silent step. Default for both `subtitle` and `narration_tts`.

subtitle.description: Text for final.srt (what the viewer reads). Default = narration. Timing still comes from the audio alignment of narration_tts (mapped proportionally when the texts differ). Empty string = no subtitle for this step.

narration_tts.description: Text sent to TTS / the external voiceover (numbers and acronyms spelled out for the AI voice, e.g. "kej pí áj" for KPI). Default = narration. Also the text used for the audio cache and stale-clip detection.

part.description: Video part (brief: 1 Úvod, 2 Nastavení, 3 Ukázka využití, 4 Pohled manažera/zaměstnance, 5 Závěr). Set it on the first step of a part; later steps without `part` inherit it. A change of part => interstitial card + chapter.

part_title.description: Title of the part (card text "<part> / <part_title>", chapter title). Needed only on the first step of the part.

hold_after_ms.description: Extra pause after audio AND actions both finished

min_duration_ms.description: Optional floor for the step even if audio is shorter

expect.description: Post-condition checked by recorder; failure => step marked failed for self-heal.

type.description: zoom = smooth page zoom on `selector` (400 ms in, hold_ms, 400 ms out; origin = element centre, moved only as far as needed to keep the zoomed element on screen; scale clamped to fit; cursor glides onto the element if it is not on it). fill = cursor clicks the field, then the whole `value` is set at once (+ input/change events) – for long texts.

selector.description: Playwright locator string. Prefer data-testid / role+text.

value.description: navigate: url; type/fill: text; press: key; select: option; wait: ms; scroll: 'down'|'up'|selector; zoom: scale, e.g. "1.6" (default 1.6)

clear.description: type: clear field first (fill always replaces the value)

delay_ms.description: type: per-char delay in ms (default 35; speed "fast" = 15; recordVideo+beacon recorder mode keeps 80 / 40). Wins over `speed`.

speed.description: type: "fast" = 15 ms per char instead of 35. For long texts prefer `fill` (instant).

hold_ms.description: zoom: how long to stay zoomed in (default 2500). Total action time = 400 ms in + hold_ms + 400 ms out.
